verdict.line: You lose trades and are the one at risk of dying solo before level 6, but Sett wins this matchup 58.9% of the time over 175 games once Grit and itemization take over.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's three-swing Q and Infernal Chains punish you for standing still, and OP.GG's own lane and solo-kill numbers say he wins that phase — but every point of damage he lands feeds your W (Haymaker) Grit, so the longer he tries to poke you down, the bigger the shield and true-damage punch you get to answer with.

theirWindow.when: Deathbringer Stance glowing + Q off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He has a free empowered auto plus a full three-swing Q (14/12/10/8/6s cooldown) coming. Do not stand in the second or third swing's zone, and expect him to follow an Infernal Chains (20/18/16/14/12s, 825 range) hit with the empowered auto for the biggest chunk of a trade.

yourWindow.when: right after his third Q swing lands
yourWindow.what: His Q is now fully spent and on a long cooldown and Umbral Dash (9/8/7/6/5s) may already be used to close. Step in and dump your stored Grit with W (Haymaker) for the shield plus true damage center-hit, then chain Q (Knuckle Down) for two enhanced-damage autos while he has no answer.

start.why: Run this on 86.2% of picks (53.4% win rate, 193 games) — the extra HP and sustain from the potion buys you room to eat his early Q pokes without dying to the trade.

boots.why: Taken on 68.9% of picks (63.4% win rate, 142 games) — Aatrox's damage is entirely physical, from his Q swings to his empowered autos, so flat reduction outvalues the Swiftness alternative here.

core.why: Highest-performing rush (68.2% win rate over 22 games in this path) — the slow on proc lets you actually stick to him once he tries to Umbral Dash away.
Shred stacks make your W true-damage hit and follow-up autos hurt more as the fight drags, which is when your Grit advantage compounds.
Adds the health pool that turns your passive's missing-health regen and W's stored Grit into a real sustain engine mid-fight.

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacked adaptive damage and healing from sustained trading directly offsets the sustain Aatrox gets from his passive and Umbral Dash — this is the higher-performing page at 63.2% win rate.

summoners.why: This is the dominant pick at 91% with a 55.7% win rate, and Ignite specifically cuts into the healing from his passive Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash, which is what keeps him ahead in extended trades.

playing.title: Track the weapon glow
playing.detail: Deathbringer Stance charges periodically and his next auto deals bonus magic damage plus a heal off your max health — back off or bait it onto a minion rather than eating it in a trade.

playing.title: Punish the third Q swing
playing.detail: His Darkin Blade fires up to three sequential swings before going on full cooldown (14/12/10/8/6s). Once the third lands, he has committed everything — step in with your stored Grit W immediately.

playing.title: Remember E only slows you solo
playing.detail: Facebreaker stuns enemies pulled from opposite sides, but 1v1 in lane you're only ever on one side of him, so it slows instead of stunning unless you use minions to sandwich him first.

playing.title: Bank Grit before you swing back
playing.detail: W's shield and true-damage punch scale off damage you've already absorbed, so taking a hit or two on purpose before popping W often nets a bigger return than dodging everything.

playing.title: Don't chase through Umbral Dash
playing.detail: His E is up almost every fight (9/8/7/6/5s cooldown) and heals him on the hit that follows — don't burn Q's move speed chasing a dash you can't catch.

playing.title: Avoid the level 6-8 all-in window
playing.detail: World Ender gives him bonus AD, healing, and move speed the moment he casts it, and the data's solo-kill edge sits with him here — play for farm, not a duel, until your first back.

playing.title: Look for your fight at 14+
playing.detail: Once Stridebreaker and Black Cleaver are online, your stick and burst outscale his stat-check ultimate — this is where the 58.9% win rate is actually won.

brief.patchCaveat: The build path, rune page, summoner spells, and every win-rate figure above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning tying them to specific cooldowns and ability behavior is my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit by Aatrox’s (Q)-(E) combo by managing your distance. If hit by his combo, use the timing of his third (Q) to hit him with [W] instead to gain the upper hand.
